description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid attacks (0.60 or 225.00 each), grants [Tri-Element Mode (Earth, Wind, Poison)], [Awoken Ninja], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Twin Destruction Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Ninja
description.text: Ninja abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ninja abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Tri-Element Mode (Earth, Wind, Poison)
description.text: Grants [Attach Earth]/[Attach Wind]/[Attach Poison] after using a Earth/Wind/Poison ability

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Poison
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Poison damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Poison resistance +20%

description.name: Twin Destruction Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Twin Destruction after using a Ninja ability

description.name: Twin Destruction
description.text: Two single hybrid attacks (4.45 or 18.36 each), ignores DEF and RES, 100% hit rate
